subject: May commitment reconciliation — usage discrepancy and VAT lookup
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@greenleaf.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@greenleaf.co
Date: 2027-05-12 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: May commitment charges — usage looks higher than expected

Hi Monica,

We just received the May invoice and the committed discount doesn't seem to have applied for two of our teams. The breakdown shows an additional 85k tokens billed at on-demand rates vs the committed tier.

Can you confirm whether the usage export you ran included prefix caching and subaccount allocations? Attached is our internal usage rollup for May (summary). If there's a billing issue we'd like to reconcile before we process the wire.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a VAT certificate for our EU entity to apply reverse-charge? Our billing team says they haven't received one.

Thanks —
Carlos
Finance Ops | Greenleaf Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@greenleaf.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12 12:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: May commitment charges — usage looks higher than expected

Thanks for the note and the summary, Carlos — I saw your upload.

Quick answers up front:
- We will run the canonical per-subaccount usage export (includes prefix/KV cache adjustments) and share the CSV by EOD.
- We can propose a one-time credit if we find the committed tier was not applied to eligible usage.
- Regarding VAT: we do require a VAT certificate or a signed VAT attestation to apply reverse-charge. If Greenleaf is registered in the EU and provides the certificate, we can zero-rate the VAT on the invoice.

Next steps: I'll pull the export and loop in Finance for credit approval. Jordan — can you review the usage CSV when I send it and advise on credit sizing (and whether to route to Vivek for exception approval)?

Carlos — please confirm the legal entity name and VAT number you intend to use for the certificate so we can match it to our billing record.

Attachments: please re-send the internal rollup as a CSV if available (your PDF was a screenshot).

Best,
Monica
Account Manager, Renewals | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13 09:40:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: May commitment charges — usage looks higher than expected

Monica — forwarding the thread after a quick skim of the May export you sent. I compared committed bucket rules vs the token attribution in the export. Two quick notes:

1) Subaccount mapping: ~72k tokens were attributed to a subaccount that was not tagged as eligible for the committed discount in our billing config (likely a product tagging miss). If the usage should have been under the committed bucket we should credit the difference.
2) Cache adjustments: ~13k tokens should be credited due to prefix caching — our runtime had a new cache warm-up behavior during a spike.

Suggested course: propose a credit memo for the net difference (attached calc sheet). Because this is >$2k equivalent, we need Vivek's sign-off for an exception credit. Vivek — can you confirm you can approve? If not, I'll escalate to finance with the supporting CSVs.

I attached: proposed_credit-memo-Greenleaf.pdf, usage_report-may2027.csv

-Jordan
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@greenleaf.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, billing@greenleaf.co
Date: 2027-05-14 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: May commitment charges — usage looks higher than expected

Carlos — thanks for your patience. We completed the reconciliation: please see the attached usage export and the proposed credit memo. Summary:

- Net overbilling identified: 85,000 tokens (72k mis-tagged + 13k cache adjustment)
- Credit proposed: EUR 1,470 (applied to the June invoice or issued as a credit memo per your preference)
- VAT status: If Greenleaf provides the EU VAT certificate (VAT ID: please confirm), we will issue the credit net of VAT and apply reverse-charge going forward. If we don't receive the certificate, tax will remain applied to the invoice and on the credit memo.

Action items for Greenleaf:
1) Confirm the legal entity for invoicing and provide the VAT registration certificate (PDF) OR confirm you want us to issue a credit including VAT.
2) Let us know if you prefer credit memo vs immediate refund.

Vivek confirmed approval for the one-time exception credit (cc'd). Jordan and I have attached the calculation and the usage CSV for your records.

Attachments: usage_report-may2027.csv; proposed_credit-memo-Greenleaf.pdf; vat_confirmation-request.pdf

Thanks — once we get the certificate we'll finalize and create the credit memo in our billing system.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Manager, Renewals | Redwood Inference
